final.role: Converts web pages, PDFs and Office files to LLM-friendly Markdown (with YAML frontmatter option) via r.jina.ai or self-hosted; also web search to Markdown
final.evidence: It converts any URL to an LLM-friendly input with https://r.jina.ai/https://your.url ... It is free, stable and scalable; runs in stateless mode via docker compose.

conferencia.nota: Useful for clipping web pages and PDFs into Markdown notes with frontmatter before indexing; not a search layer.
